interface.longDescription: KOSIF Think v1.5.3 refreshes live MCP discovery for kosif_mobile_think, kosif_mobile_capabilities and kosif_mobile_call, including indirect access to kosif_auto and kosif_route when the host does not expose those runtime tools directly, while preserving adaptive Fast/Council/Deep routing, Jev gates, verification receipts, self-tests and diagnostics.
defaultPrompt: When KOSIF Think is explicitly selected, call kosif_mobile_think before substantive downstream execution; use auto mode unless the user explicitly forces Fast, Council, or Deep.

Use kosif_mobile_capabilities when exact live schemas are needed. If kosif_auto or kosif_route is not directly exposed by the current host, call it through kosif_mobile_call; use the same bridge for advanced operations such as kosif_self_test or kosif_diagnostics.
KOSIF Think never grants permission for side effects by itself; require fresh verification and executor-originated receipts for remote actions.

name: kosif-think
description: Adaptive mobile-first KOSIF Think router with refreshed live MCP discovery for Think tools, auto Fast/Council/Deep selection, Jev gates, verification receipts, self-tests and diagnostics.
